$comment: Art directions for the frozen benchmark briefs, written by the art-direction step BEFORE any runtime config existed.
Each is a translation of its brief into the vocabulary of the medium, not a restatement of it.
No field names a runtime parameter; validateDirection refuses one that does.

B01.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure built by repeating a production on itself in regular primitives.
B01.motifTranslation: The colonnade becomes a nested series of rectilinear bays, each generation inscribed within the last, so interval and weight survive while perspective is discarded entirely.
B01.composition: A compact centred structure held clear of the frame edge, its margin left empty on all four sides so the run of bays reads as an object rather than a fragment.
B01.focalHierarchy: One dominant outer bay commands the frame; the inner generations descend in scale and read as secondary structure at browse size.
B01.density: Moderate. The structure carries real weight without crowding, occupying rather more than a third of the frame at browse size.
B01.negativeSpace: The empty margin is structural, not left over: it isolates the colonnade so the rhythm of supports is legible against nothing.
B01.paletteIntent: Restrained industrial: iron and ash over a near black ground, with one warm ochre accent reserved for the innermost bay.
B01.rhythm: Regular repetition at a steady contraction, each bay the same member at a smaller scale, with the interval never broken.
B01.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in the silhouette of the bay member, then in the symmetry order that replicates it, then in how deep the run goes.
B01.marketTransformation: Under drawdown members are removed and the run opens out; in recovery the colonnade fills back in and the nesting deepens.
B01.identityAnchors: The centred rectilinear run, the near black ground and the iron and ochre pairing hold constant across every seed and state.
B01.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the stepped silhouette of a nested run survives; the interior articulation does not, and is not asked to.

B02.medium: Vector composition: several fields of stroked primitives placed about the canvas centre by a chosen layout.
B02.motifTranslation: The frond becomes a radiating field of fine linear members, each division shorter and turned from the last, so growth is expressed as branching interval rather than as a drawn leaf.
B02.composition: A compact radiating figure held near the centre with clear space at the frame edge, so the form reads as one growth rather than as scattered marks.
B02.focalHierarchy: One dense central cluster anchors the work and the radiating members thin outward as secondary incident.
B02.density: Sparse and delicate. Few members, generous emptiness, the drawing carried in line rather than in filled mass anywhere.
B02.negativeSpace: The emptiness around the radiating figure is where the growth has not yet reached, and it must stay open and quiet.
B02.paletteIntent: Quiet and organic: moss and bone over a dark ground, low contrast, so the linework reads as thread rather than as structure.
B02.rhythm: Regular division at a steady angular turn, each generation repeating the last at a smaller reach with no interruption.
B02.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in how far the branching has extended, then in the density of members, then in the palette rotation.
B02.marketTransformation: Recovery extends the branching outward and multiplies its divisions; stress retracts the form back toward a bare central armature.
B02.identityAnchors: The centred radiating figure, the dark ground and the moss and bone pairing stay constant across every seed and every state.
B02.thumbnailIntent: At 120px a radiating star of fine lines survives as silhouette; the individual divisions do not resolve and need not.

B03.medium: Vector composition: stacked fields of filled primitives placed about the canvas centre in a layered arrangement.
B03.motifTranslation: The core sample becomes horizontal bands of differing thickness stacked one above another, so deposition is expressed as sequence and pitch rather than as depicted rock.
B03.composition: The banding runs wide across the frame and reaches toward the edges, filling the field so the section reads as continuous rather than as an isolated object.
B03.focalHierarchy: No single band dominates; the work is a layered sequence in which relative thickness and colour create a legible order.
B03.density: Dense. The bands crowd the frame with little rest between them, reading as accumulated mass at browse size.
B03.negativeSpace: What emptiness exists sits between beds as the thin partings of a sequence, never as a margin around the whole.
B03.paletteIntent: Earth: umber, ochre and sand with one cold slate band, over a dark base, values close enough to read as sediment.
B03.rhythm: Regular horizontal repetition at varying pitch, the interval between beds changing so the eye reads a sequence not a texture.
B03.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in how many beds they carry, then in the spacing between them, then in which band takes the cold colour.
B03.marketTransformation: Under drawdown the beds thin and fewer survive; in recovery the sequence thickens and more beds return to the section.
B03.identityAnchors: The horizontal banding, the dark base and the earth palette hold constant across every seed and every market state.
B03.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the striped horizontal sequence survives; individual bed edges do not resolve and are not required to.

B04.medium: Vector composition: fields of primitives distributed about the canvas centre with no depicted subject at all.
B04.motifTranslation: There is no motif to translate. The work is an arrangement of marks whose only content is the interval between them and their distribution across the field.
B04.composition: An all over field that uses the whole frame evenly, with no isolated object and no reserved margin anywhere in the composition.
B04.focalHierarchy: Deliberately flat hierarchy: nothing dominates, and the even distribution is the point rather than an absence of decision.
B04.density: Moderate. Enough marks that the field reads as populated, few enough that individual intervals remain legible at browse size.
B04.negativeSpace: Negative space is distributed rather than pooled, appearing as the gaps between marks across the entire field evenly.
B04.paletteIntent: Narrow and tonal: close values in slate and bone over a dark ground, so difference reads as spacing rather than as colour.
B04.rhythm: Regular distribution with local variation, the interval steady enough to establish a measure and loose enough to avoid a grid.
B04.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in the count of marks, then in their distribution, then in the subtle palette rotation across the field.
B04.marketTransformation: The market acts on the density of the field: markedly more marks under drawdown and fewer in recovery, visible at browse size.
B04.identityAnchors: The even all over field, the dark ground and the narrow tonal palette stay constant across every seed and every state.
B04.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the overall density and grain of the field survives; individual marks do not resolve and are not meant to.

B05.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure built from regular primitives over a flat ground.
B05.motifTranslation: The stele becomes a single upright nested mass, one generation inside the last, so the monument is expressed as concentration rather than as depicted stone.
B05.composition: A single compact form centred and held well clear of every edge, with the frame reading as mostly empty around it.
B05.focalHierarchy: One dominant mass and nothing else of consequence; any inner structure is texture subordinate to the single silhouette.
B05.density: Sparse and austere. Very few elements, the mass occupying well under half the frame at browse size.
B05.negativeSpace: The surrounding emptiness does as much work as the mass and is the reason the object reads as placed rather than as drawn.
B05.paletteIntent: Two values and a ground: bone against charcoal over near black, nothing decorative and no third colour anywhere.
B05.rhythm: Regular contraction inward, each generation a steady step smaller, with no interruption and no ornament.
B05.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in the silhouette of the single form, then in its symmetry, then in how many generations it holds.
B05.marketTransformation: The market changes the form's scale rather than its complexity: it contracts under drawdown and expands again in recovery.
B05.identityAnchors: The single centred mass, the near black ground and the two value palette hold constant across every seed and every state.
B05.thumbnailIntent: At 120px one compact silhouette survives and reads immediately as a single object; interior steps do not resolve.

B06.medium: Vector composition: several dense fields of filled primitives distributed about the canvas centre.
B06.motifTranslation: The thicket becomes overlapping fields of small members at several scales, so profusion is expressed as accumulated incident rather than as depicted growth.
B06.composition: The fields spread wide and reach toward the edges, filling the frame so there is no rest and no isolated object anywhere.
B06.focalHierarchy: Layered rather than singular: a dense primary field with two secondary fields threading through it at different scales.
B06.density: Dense to near saturation. Crowded, teeming and intricate, with structure at every scale and no empty quarter.
B06.negativeSpace: There is almost no negative space by intent; what little exists is the incidental gap between members, never a margin.
B06.paletteIntent: Warm and dark: rust, copper and umber piled over a near black ground, values close so density reads as mass.
B06.rhythm: Irregular repetition, the interval broken and varied so the field reads as profusion rather than as pattern.
B06.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in density, then in the distribution of the secondary fields, then in palette rotation.
B06.marketTransformation: Under stress the thicket thins dramatically and opens; in recovery it closes again, and the difference is obvious at browse size.
B06.identityAnchors: The warm dark palette, the near black ground and the multi scale overlapping construction hold across every seed and state.
B06.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the overall mass and its dense grain survive; individual members do not resolve and are not meant to.

B07.medium: Vector composition: fields of rounded primitives placed about the canvas centre in a radiating arrangement.
B07.motifTranslation: The colony becomes clustered rounded members budding outward from a shared centre, so accretion is expressed as radial packing rather than as depicted cells.
B07.composition: A centred cluster that spreads outward toward the frame without reaching the edge, so the colony reads as a growth with room to grow.
B07.focalHierarchy: One dense centre dominates and the members thin outward, so the eye starts at the core and follows the spread.
B07.density: Dense. The colony packs closely at the centre and remains substantial toward its edge at browse size.
B07.negativeSpace: The clear space beyond the colony's reach is where it has not yet grown, and it must remain open on all sides.
B07.paletteIntent: Damp and mineral: verdigris and bone over deep ink, low contrast, so the forms read as biological rather than bright.
B07.rhythm: Radial repetition with local irregularity, members budding at varied interval so the packing reads as grown not placed.
B07.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in how far the colony has spread, then in how densely it packs, then in its palette rotation.
B07.marketTransformation: Recovery pushes the colony outward and multiplies its members; stress pulls it back toward the centre and reduces it.
B07.identityAnchors: The centred radial cluster, the deep ink ground and the verdigris and bone pairing hold across every seed and state.
B07.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the round clustered silhouette and its density gradient survive; individual members do not resolve.

B08.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure replicated by a symmetry order over a flat ground.
B08.motifTranslation: The escapement becomes nested concentric rings of radial members, each ring a turned repetition of the last, so rotational logic is expressed without any literal mechanism part.
B08.composition: A centred concentric figure held clear of the frame edge, the rings reading as one assembly rather than as separate circles.
B08.focalHierarchy: The outer ring dominates and the inner rings descend in scale as secondary structure, with the centre reading as a stop.
B08.density: Moderate. Enough members that the assembly reads as engineered, few enough that individual radial members stay legible.
B08.negativeSpace: The margin outside the outer ring isolates the mechanism so its rotational order is legible against nothing.
B08.paletteIntent: Brass and slate over a dark ground, drawing carried in fine line so the whole reads as engineering rather than as mass.
B08.rhythm: Regular rotational repetition at a fixed angular interval, each ring turned from the one inside it by a steady step.
B08.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in rotational symmetry order, then in how many rings they carry, then in the member silhouette.
B08.marketTransformation: Under volatility the rings separate and the members spread apart; as conditions settle the assembly tightens again.
B08.identityAnchors: The centred concentric construction, the dark ground and the brass and slate pairing hold across every seed and state.
B08.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the concentric ring silhouette and its rotational order survive; individual members do not resolve.

B09.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure built from a few large regular primitives.
B09.motifTranslation: The barrow becomes a single massive nested form built from few large members, so weight is expressed as scale and consolidation rather than as depicted earth.
B09.composition: One mass that reaches well toward the frame edges and feels larger than the frame comfortably holds, with little clear space.
B09.focalHierarchy: One overwhelming dominant mass; inner generations are few and large so they read as part of the same silhouette.
B09.density: Dense in the mass and empty outside it: the form is solid where it exists and occupies most of the frame.
B09.negativeSpace: The little space that remains reads as pressure around the mass rather than as a comfortable margin.
B09.paletteIntent: Charcoal and iron with a single ochre seam over near black, low contrast so the mass reads as weight.
B09.rhythm: Regular but coarse repetition, few large steps rather than many small ones, so the rhythm is slow and heavy.
B09.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in the silhouette of the mass, then in its symmetry, then in where the ochre seam falls.
B09.marketTransformation: Under drawdown the mass fractures and its members separate and the silhouette breaks; in recovery it consolidates again.
B09.identityAnchors: It must remain the same object in all three states: the centred heavy mass and the charcoal and ochre pairing never change.
B09.thumbnailIntent: At 120px one heavy silhouette survives and reads as a single immovable object; the fracture is visible as broken outline.

B10.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure drawn entirely in outline over a flat ground.
B10.motifTranslation: The filigree becomes a radiating figure of hairline members repeating outward at diminishing scale, so fragility is expressed as thinness and reach rather than as depicted metal.
B10.composition: A radiating figure that reaches out toward the frame without touching it, so the threads read as extending into open space.
B10.focalHierarchy: No heavy dominant element: a light centre and threads of even weight, with hierarchy carried by reach rather than by mass.
B10.density: Sparse and light. Very little ink, the work reading as provisional and easily disturbed at browse size.
B10.negativeSpace: The open space the threads reach into is most of the frame and is the reason the figure reads as fragile.
B10.paletteIntent: Pale and cool: bone and pale slate over a dark ground, contrast kept low so lines read as thread not structure.
B10.rhythm: Regular radial repetition at a fine interval, each generation reaching further and thinning as it goes outward.
B10.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in the symmetry of the figure, then in how far the threads extend, then in their fineness.
B10.marketTransformation: The figure opens outward in recovery and draws inward under stress, carried by geometry rather than by weight.
B10.identityAnchors: The centred radiating outline, the dark ground and the bone and slate pairing hold across every seed and every state.
B10.thumbnailIntent: At 120px a fine radiating figure survives as a light silhouette; individual threads do not resolve and need not.

B11.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure whose structure is driven hard by the market reading.
B11.motifTranslation: There is no motif beyond condition itself. The work is a centred structure whose extent and completeness are the entire subject.
B11.composition: A centred structure whose reach changes markedly between states, held within the frame at its widest so nothing is lost at the edge.
B11.focalHierarchy: One dominant central structure throughout, so that identity survives even when its extent and density change sharply.
B11.density: Moderate at neutral, deliberately so, leaving room to read as both sparse under stress and dense in recovery.
B11.negativeSpace: The empty frame around the structure is what makes its expansion and contraction legible between the three states.
B11.paletteIntent: Slate and iron with copper held in reserve, over a dark ground, so warmth reads as recovery without the palette itself moving.
B11.rhythm: Regular repetition whose interval widens and narrows with condition, the measure staying recognisable throughout.
B11.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in silhouette, then in symmetry order, then in how far the structure reaches at neutral.
B11.marketTransformation: This is the subject: sparse and broken under stress, dense and whole in recovery, with neutral visibly between them.
B11.identityAnchors: The same token must stay the same token in all three states: centred construction, ground and palette never change.
B11.thumbnailIntent: At 120px the difference between the three states must be unmistakable as silhouette and density, not as fine detail.

B12.medium: Geometric recursion: one centred self-similar figure of concentric enclosures over a flat ground.
B12.motifTranslation: The reliquary becomes a set of concentric enclosures, one boundary inside another, holding a small dense centre, so containment is expressed as nesting rather than as depicted vessel.
B12.composition: A small centred figure held far clear of every edge, with most of the frame given over to the surrounding dark.
B12.focalHierarchy: The dense small centre is the focus and the enclosures around it are secondary boundaries that frame rather than compete.
B12.density: Sparse and still. Very little of the frame carries ink, and what does is concentrated near the centre.
B12.negativeSpace: The surrounding dark is most of the work and reads as settled emptiness rather than as unused space.
B12.paletteIntent: Gold and umber over deep ink, used sparingly, with the gold reserved for the centre and the enclosures in umber.
B12.rhythm: Regular concentric repetition at a quiet even interval, unhurried, with no break and no accent in the spacing.
B12.variationStrategy: Tokens differ first in the number of enclosures, then in the character of the centre they hold, then in symmetry.
B12.marketTransformation: The market registers only faintly as a slight tightening or loosening of the enclosures, never as drama.
B12.identityAnchors: The centred concentric construction, the deep ink ground and the gold centre hold across every seed and every state.
B12.thumbnailIntent: At 120px a small bright centre inside quiet concentric boundaries survives; the enclosure count does not resolve.
